name: tts-cpp
description: Text-to-speech in pure C++/ggml: Resemble Chatterbox (Turbo + Multilingual), Supertonic, Fun-CosyVoice3, Parler-TTS (CPU + Metal / Vulkan / OpenCL GPU), and LavaSR speech enhancement. Sourced from tetherto/qvac-ext-lib-whisper.cpp (engines/tts). This pin (master HEAD d6b00d95, PR #119) lets the validated Parler pipeline select Vulkan on ARM Mali when GPU execution is requested, instead of silently falling back to CPU on Pixel hardware. Explicit CPU execution remains unchanged. It carries PR #118's CosyVoice3 GPU path and the ggml-speech 2026-08-03 floor required by that release, plus the dl-safe backend init (PR #117), bounded Parler DAC decode (PR #114), full Parler Vulkan pipeline (PR #110), Metal GPU support (PR #103), and the original CosyVoice3 engine (PR #99).
